title: Ladybird
words: In the game there's an enournmous amount of maps you play in, and there's many maps that most of the map consists of grass terrain.  So I was wondering if I make a concepts of a car that revolves around that.  I obviously don't want to fall in the cliche camoufaldge skin though.  Although I do want something that feels fun and it just makes sense to use it when in maps like those.  I still don't know what I want, so Im happy to figure it out as I go

steps.name: Brief
steps.decision: a ladybird in the grass: a bright red top that stands out, a fringe of grass along the bottom

steps.name: Mood
steps.decision: both carried into the concepts: Field guide (matte vermilion, ink, paper, sage, an ink-drawn fringe, the Latin name) and Racing colours (satin red, big black spots, cream rail line, a sharp graphic fringe, a saddle-cloth 7)

was.decision: matte vermilion, ink black, paper and sage; an ink-drawn grass fringe, the Latin name as lettering

steps.name: Concepts
steps.decision: B's silks (satin red, big black spots clear of the inlets and the number) with C's turf-green grass rising up the lower sides

steps.name: Shapes
steps.decision: the round white marks on the black head; the grass all round the car, a fringe along the head's lower edge and a lawn under it

was.decision: the round white marks on the black head, as the user asked; the grass stops where the head begins

steps.name: Colours and materials
steps.decision: Beetle gloss with satin grass: the shell, spots, head and marks glossy under a clear varnish, the grass a silky satin

steps.name: Wheels
steps.decision: Grass line: gloss black covers, a thin turf-green stripe round each tyre on a slick tread, the wheel rings' light turf green

steps.name: Details
steps.decision: satin black inner car; the floor and front wing green like the grass, carbon under the tail; glossy black frames; the speed numbers and gear lights grass green; the glass clear

was.decision: satin black inner car, carbon underneath, glossy black frames round the inlets and the speed display; the speed numbers and gear lights grass green; the glass clear

steps.name: Lettering
steps.decision: none: the ladybird says it without words

steps.name: Review
steps.decision: Claude's own review: nothing left in clay, graphics clean at every join, reads from the cameras day and night, the number panels free, 2.95 MB; the diffuser's fins made solid green

steps.name: Road test
steps.why: the user: "Let's assume it works" (not driven in the game)
